label: Latent matching-prefix probability in the two-class supplier mixture
definition: At query length k the latent matching-prefix probability is w + (1 − w) · depthLikelihood(prior, k), with depthLikelihood the sourced conditional matching-prefix probability. The endless class always matches the latent prefix.
note: The endless population share w lies in [0, 1] and the conditional sourced prior is fixed, nonnegative, and normalized for the probability reading. A common observation factor multiplies both class probabilities at a given length in the factored models. A visibility probability of zero removes all prefix observations at that length.
